content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Ropar Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar). It is a prestigious government institution offering excellent career opportunities in research and academia.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Post-Doctoral Fellow. This position is ideal for researchers looking to advance their academic careers.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position. Candidates are encouraged to apply promptly as competition may be high.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Ropar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position is 15 September 2026. Ensure all documents are submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. degree or have a Thesis submission certificate in Computational biology. This ensures applicants possess the necessary academic background for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: The selected Post-Doctoral Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 60,000 per month, along with HRA as per the institute rules. This is a competitive remuneration package.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates need to send their complete application and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the IIT Ropar Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position. This makes it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an Online Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications before the interview stage.
